evidence.markdown_summary:
# Flash Next throughput A/B

Apple M2 Ultra 192 GiB development evidence. Not Mac mini M5 64 GB or Mac Studio M5 Ultra 256 GB target-SKU performance.

| Pack | Prompt tokens | Route | Prefill tok/s median | Decode tok/s median | TTFT s median | Peak MLX bytes median |
| --- | ---: | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 4bit | 512 | AX direct | 122.191 | 18.876 | 4.190 | 94587718758 |
| 4bit | 2048 | AX direct | 100.890 | 17.811 | 20.299 | 100642735438 |
| 4bit | 8192 | AX direct | 85.148 | 116.828 | 96.209 | 100651586478 |
| 4bit | 512 | reference | 466.859 | 22.309 | 1.097 | 131426585982 |
| 4bit | 2048 | reference | 533.151 | 18.203 | 3.841 | 133784069260 |
| 4bit | 8192 | reference | 465.082 | 18.266 | 17.614 | 133835105420 |
| 4bit | 512 | AX MTP | 121.620 | 21.724 | 4.210 | 94590883134 |
| 4bit | 2048 | AX MTP | 99.687 | 18.067 | 20.544 | 100656811630 |
| 4bit | 8192 | AX MTP | 84.173 | 21.775 | 97.324 | 100665594254 |
| 6bit | 512 | AX direct | 37.031 | 38.933 | 13.826 | 19896203040 |
| 6bit | 2048 | AX direct | 34.258 | 10.679 | 59.781 | 35477126314 |
| 6bit | 8192 | AX direct | skipped:skip_cell | n/a | n/a | n/a |

Prefill tok/s uses prompt tokens / time to first token. Decode tok/s uses
generation_tokens / post-first-token interval (mlx_lm.benchmark contract).
All numbers are M2 Ultra evidence, not target-SKU performance.
limitations: Apple M2 Ultra 192 GiB development evidence. Not Mac mini M5 64 GB or Mac Studio M5 Ultra 256 GB target-SKU performance.
mlx_lm.benchmark is not used because it has no qwen4_exp model.
AX and reference share prompt token ids and the same prefill chunk size.
Prefill seconds equal time to first token from the SSE stream (AX) or from the last prefill logits (reference).
Decode tokens per second uses generation_tokens divided by the post-first-token interval.
Expert residency is Auto; on the 192 GiB host the 4-bit and 6-bit packs stay resident.
Peak MLX bytes are recorded for the in-process reference and, for AX cells, from ax_engine_memory_mlx_peak_bytes on /metrics.
AX cells also record /metrics selected-expert counters and memory gauges so a paged or memory-pressured cell is visible in the artifact.
Operator stage names are the runtime attribution catalog; this harness does not run the synchronized profiler.
Not a qualification record, not a public README claim, and not M5 Ultra SKU evidence.
Historical results do not validate a newer binary or merged commit.
Recorded thresholds are retained, not a new certification decision.
An unverified harness hash is an open reproducibility gate.
